description: Cary Broadband Internet Access is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by U.S. Census Bureau. Part of the What Works Cities criterion to achieve Certification, we need to meet the industry standard of at least 75% of our households have subscriptions / access to high-speed broadband services Part of the American Community Survey (ACS) asks the levels of internet access residents have. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Services, Social. Its keywords are census, American Community Survey. The portal shows 4 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
